import re
def money(v):
    s=str(v).strip().lower().replace('đ','')
    m=re.fullmatch(r'(-?)(\d+)tr(\d*)',s)
    if m: return (-1 if m.group(1) else 1)*(int(m.group(2))*1000000+int((m.group(3)+'000')[:3] if m.group(3) else 0)*1000)
    if re.fullmatch(r'-?\d{1,3}(\.\d{3})+',s): return float(s.replace('.',''))
    return float(s.replace(',','')) if re.fullmatch(r'-?[\d,]*\.?\d+',s) else float('nan')

RESULT=f"{(a-b)/b*100:.2f}%"
